Hero.h1: Industrial Skylights, Polycarbonate Roofing & Roof Ventilation for Egypt

Footer.text: Manufacturer and exporter of polycarbonate skylights, glazing panels and roof ventilation systems, engineered in India and supplied to Egypt and other markets worldwide.

about: For skylights Egypt projects, Dura Plast supplies Rhino Tuff industrial skylights, skylight polycarbonate sheet, FRP roofing and roof ventilation for factories, warehouses and commercial buildings in Cairo, Alexandria and across Egypt. One manufacturer covers daylight, airflow and roofing from design to fitment, and quotes the full package once you send your roof details.

Established in **2010**, Dura Plast designs, manufactures and delivers the Rhino Tuff range: skylight domes, barrel vault skylights, tubular skylights, polycarbonate and FRP roofing, roof curbs and turbine ventilators. The Egypt range is the same engineered product line, matched to the steel, sandwich panel and flat roofs found on industrial buildings.

From first specification through delivery and fitment, we provide tailor-made, turn-key daylighting and ventilation solutions. Send your roof drawings or profile and we propose the product, curb and layout.

footprint.heading: Industrial skylights for Egypt
paragraphs: Egypt's factories, warehouses and commercial buildings get strong sun for most of the year, so a skylight has to bring in daylight without bringing in heat. For industrial skylights Egypt projects, the Rhino Tuff range is matched to the roof underneath:

items.label: Steel roofs:
items.text: [polycarbonate skylight domes](https://www.duraplastindia.com/eg/product/rhino-tuff-polycarbonate-skylight-domes-for-steel-roofs), thermally insulated and made of UV-protected polycarbonate that is 90% transparent.

items.label: Sandwich panel roofs:
items.text: [thermally insulated skylights](https://www.duraplastindia.com/eg/product/rhino-tuff-polycarbonate-thermal-insulated-skylights-for-sandwich-panels) with a double-skin build that limits solar heat.

items.label: Flat roofs:
items.text: [dome skylights](https://www.duraplastindia.com/eg/product/rhino-tuff-polycarbonate-skylight-domes-for-flat-roofs) on FRP up-stands, single to triple glazed, fixed or openable.

items.label: Standing seam roofs:
items.text: [barrel vault skylights](https://www.duraplastindia.com/eg/product/rhino-tuff-polycarbonate-skylights-barrel-vaults-for-standing-seam-roofs) and [standing seam panels](https://www.duraplastindia.com/eg/product/polycarbonate-standing-seam-panel-systems), fixed without penetrating the roof.

items.label: Deep interiors:
items.text: [tubular skylights](https://www.duraplastindia.com/eg/product/rhino-tuff-tubular-skylights) that pipe daylight into dark floor areas, and clear acrylic [plexiglass domes](https://www.duraplastindia.com/eg/product/rhino-tuff-plexiglass-domes).

outro: Specify UV-protected glazing and a properly flashed curb. Whichever of these skylights a project needs, send the roof profile and we match the dome, curb and layout in one quote. Barrel vault and dome skylights also suit atriums, lobbies and shopping walkways, and the Light and Air range pairs a skylight with a [turbine ventilator in a single roof opening](https://www.duraplastindia.com/eg/product/rhino-tuff-skylight-dome-turbine-ventilator-combos).

footprint.heading: Roof ventilation for Egyptian warehouses and factories
paragraphs: Hot, stale air collects under steel roofs. For roof ventilation Egypt facilities need, Rhino Tuff offers four ways to move it out:

items.label: Wind-driven turbine ventilators:
items.text: [free-spinning whirlybirds](https://www.duraplastindia.com/eg/product/rhino-tuff-wind-driven-turbine-ventilators) that use wind to exhaust hot air, smoke, gases and dust at no operating cost, even at relatively low wind speeds.

items.label: Hybrid ventilators:
items.text: a [motorised axial fan under a turbine ventilator](https://www.duraplastindia.com/eg/product/rhino-tuff-hybrid-ventilators) for both natural and forced ventilation.

items.label: Skylight and turbine ventilator combos:
items.text: daylight and extraction from one roof opening, mounted on FRP roof curbs made for the roof.

items.label: Polycarbonate louvers:
items.text: [sidelight and ventilation in one](https://www.duraplastindia.com/eg/product/rhino-tuff-polycarbonate-louvers) for the side cladding of metal frame buildings.

faq.q: Which skylight suits a steel roof in Egypt?
faq.a: Polycarbonate skylight domes for steel roofs are made for corrugated steel and sandwich panel roofs. They are thermally insulated, 90% transparent and fixed on UV-stable FRP curbs with thermal liner panels for a leak-proof fit.

faq.q: How do I limit heat from daylighting under Egypt's sun?
faq.a: Choose UV-protected glazing and a multi-glazed or double-skin product. Multi-glazed domes and thermally insulated skylights limit solar heat transfer, and Rhino Solar Heat Colours on sheets block heat-causing IR rays.

faq.q: Can warehouses in Egypt ventilate without electricity?
faq.a: Yes. Wind-driven turbine ventilators use wind to exhaust hot, stale air, smoke, gases and dust at no operating cost. Where forced extraction is also needed, a hybrid ventilator adds a motorised axial fan under the turbine.

faq.q: What is the difference between polycarbonate and FRP roofing sheets?
faq.a: Polycarbonate sheets are lightweight, shatterproof and clear or tinted, so they work as skylight panels between metal sheets. FRP sheets are fibreglass, coloured or translucent, and suit corrosive process industries and seaside locations.

faq.q: What details do you need for a quote?
faq.a: Send the roof type, the sheet or panel profile or roof drawings, the project city and the approximate area. Dura Plast then matches the product, curb and layout in one quote.

faq.q: Do you supply projects in Cairo and Alexandria?
faq.a: Dura Plast is an Indian manufacturer that exports Rhino Tuff products and quotes projects in Cairo, Alexandria and elsewhere in Egypt.

faq.q: What affects polycarbonate sheets price in Egypt?
faq.a: The price follows the specification: size, thickness, colour or tint, surface texture, UV coating and quantity. Sheets are made in these options, so send the specification and Dura Plast quotes against it.

faq.q: Is a multiwall polycarbonate sheet the same as a hollow sheet?
faq.a: Yes, both names describe a polycarbonate sheet with hollow cells between its walls. Rhino Tuff uses this multi-wall, multi-cell build in its standing seam panels, which give thermal and acoustic insulation.
